FAMEAIS is the renewed FAME+ Erasmus Mundus programme — functional advanced materials engineering now with artificial intelligence for sustainability — organised by UCLouvain, Grenoble INP, TU Darmstadt, Augsburg and Aveiro. Its application round closes in January each year, with the exact date on the admissions page.

Programme Highlights

  • Twenty-year FAME tradition renewed with an AI-for-sustainability layer
  • Five-university consortium across Belgium, France, Germany and Portugal
  • January closing pattern for the scholarship round
  • Graduates in materials R&D, energy materials and AI-driven design

Who Should Apply

Materials, chemistry, physics and engineering graduates are the core audience; programming interest helps with the new AI components.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the FAMEAIS admissions page for the January cut-off and apply through the consortium form. Key deadline information: Application deadline falls in January for the following autumn (annual cycle) — exact date on the admissions page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About FAMEAIS Consortium (UCLouvain)

The FAMEAIS consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Functional Advanced Materials Engineering with Artificial Intelligence for Sustainability, coordinated from UCLouvain with Grenoble INP, TU Darmstadt, Augsburg and Aveiro.

Official website: https://www.fame-master.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Application deadline falls in January - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
